prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: parking lot collision in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1195; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: On the afternoon of the reported incident, I responded to a parking lot in Katy, Texas, where a two-vehicle collision had been reported at low speed. Driver 1 was reportedly backing out of a space when the rear of the vehicle struck the front quarter of a vehicle driven by Driver 2. Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time. Officers on scene and people present in the lot confirmed that Passenger and Driver 1 were in the vehicle when it moved. No independent witness saw the impact itself. Driver 1 reported a concussion with headache and dizziness, which is consistent with the forces expected in a collision of this type. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to both vehicles that lines up with the described contact point, and I found no indication of earlier damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. Driver 2 reported no injuries. Both drivers exchanged information, and a copy of the scene photographs has been placed in the case file.
